name: Live Sales for WooCommerce
author: interactivecomms

sections.description:
Experience the future of interactive commerce with Live Sales for WooCommerce plugin. Accelerate your sales process with ultra-low latency, enabling you to close deals faster than ever. Leverage the power of live streaming to enhance your online sales strategy.

Third party libraries/services used in this plugin

  1. Ant Media Server and their SDK to provide live streaming services.
    Website: https://antmedia.io

  2. Font Awesome Free

    • Version: 6.6.0
    • License: Font Awesome Free License (MIT, OFL, and CC BY 4.0)
    • License URL: https://fontawesome.com/license/free
    • Author: Fonticons, Inc.
    • Website: https://fontawesome.com/

  3. Krajee jQuery DateTime Picker

    • Version: 1.3.3
    • Author: Kartik Visweswaran (Krajee.com)
    • Source: https://plugins.krajee.com
    • License: BSD 3-Clause License
    • License URL: https://github.com/kartik-v/php-date-formatter/blob/master/LICENSE.md

  4. webrtc-adapter

    • Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/webrtc-adapter@9.0.3/out/adapter.js
    • Version: 9.0.3
    • License: BSD-3-Clause
    • Website: https://www.npmjs.com/package/webrtc-adapter

  5. Select2

    • Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/select2@4.1.0-rc.0/dist/js/select2.min.js
    • Version: 4.1.0-rc.0
    • License: MIT
    • Website: https://select2.org/
    • GitHub: https://github.com/select2/select2

Prerequisite

  • WooCommerce
  • Ant Media Server application credentials.

Features

  • Seamless Integration: Connects effortlessly with WooCommerce and AntMedia Server.
  • Live Streaming: Go live and showcase your products in real-time.
  • Interactive Chat: Engage with customers directly through integrated chat.
  • Quick Setup: Configure settings and go live within 5 minutes!
  • Boost Sales: Live demos with direct purchasing options to increase conversion rates.
  • Logo & Marquee: Display your brand logo along with product details information in marquee during live selling.
  • Live customers count : Get the viewer count info on your dashboard in real time.
  • LIVESAFO Agent Role: Allow you to create multiple staff or agents role. With the flexibility to schedule unlimited live sales, the possibilities are endless.

Why You’ll Love It

  • This plugin is designed for ease of use and flexibility. Whether you’re running a small boutique or a large-scale online store, you’ll find it incredibly easy to set up and start broadcasting your products live. Imagine the possibilities of hosting live product launches, Q&A sessions, or exclusive sales events! Ready to Elevate Your Online Store? Let’s make online selling more dynamic and interactive than ever. Your customers will love the personal touch, and you’ll love the sales report! Happy live selling!
sections.installation:
• Upload live-sales-for-woocommerce.zip to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
    • Validate WooCommerce is activated. If not please install woocommerce plugin and activate through ‘Plugins’ menu in wordpress.
    • Activate ‘Live Sales for WooCommerce’ plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
    • Go to setting page and enter antmedia server demo credentials mentioned there. Click on save to continue.
    • Go to schedule menu and schedule timing of live sale.
    • Enter the shortcode on any page where you want your viewer to watch your live sale stream.
    • Click on Go live to start live sales.
sections.faq:
Is this require woocommerce to be installed

Yes.
